apiKey.label: Private API Key
apiKey.description: Authenticate using your Klaviyo Private API Key. In Klaviyo go to Settings > API Keys, click Create Private API Key, give it a name and the required scopes, then copy the key (starts with pk_).

createProfile.label: Create Profile
createProfile.description: Add new user profile with email/SMS subscription options

custom_properties.label: Custom Properties
custom_properties.description: Key-value pairs for segmentation and personalization

updateProfile.label: Update Profile
updateProfile.description: Update existing profile data and preferences.

external_id.label: External ID
external_id.description: Unique identifier from external system (e.g., POS system)

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: Locale in IETF BCP 47 format (e.g., en-US)

image.label: Image URL
image.description: URL pointing to profile image location

country.label: Country Code

custom_properties.label: Custom Properties
custom_properties.description: Key/value pairs for custom profile properties

include_predictive_analytics.label: Include Predictive Analytics
include_predictive_analytics.description: Include predictive analytics data in response

addProfileToList.label: Add Profile to List
addProfileToList.description: Add profiles to a specific list without changing subscription status.

profile_id.label: Profile Ids
profile_id.description: Select one or more Klaviyo profiles. Several IDs go in as a JSON array, such as ["01H...","01J..."].

createList.label: Create List

findListByName.label: Find List by Name
findListByName.description: Find lists by name with optional additional data

include_additional_data.label: Include Additional Data
include_additional_data.description: Include related flow and tag information

findProfileByEmailPhone.label: Find Profile by Email/Phone
findProfileByEmailPhone.description: Find a profile using email or phone number.

search_query.label: Email or Phone Number
search_query.description: Enter an email address or phone number (E.164 format recommended)

include_additional_data.label: Include Additional Data
include_additional_data.description: Include subscriptions and predictive analytics data

findTagByName.label: Find Tag by Name
findTagByName.description: Find tags whose name contains the search query.

search_query.label: Tag Name
search_query.description: Search for tags whose name contains this value.

subscribeProfile.label: Subscribe Profile
subscribeProfile.description: Subscribe profiles to email or SMS marketing on a list.

profile_ids.label: Profile Ids
profile_ids.description: Select one or more Klaviyo profiles. Several IDs go in as a JSON array, such as ["01H...","01J..."].

subscribe_email.label: Subscribe to Email
subscribe_email.description: Subscribe selected profiles to email marketing.

subscribe_sms.label: Subscribe to SMS
subscribe_sms.description: Subscribe selected profiles to SMS marketing.

historical_import.label: Historical Import
historical_import.description: Bypass double opt-in and mark as a historical import.

consented_at.label: Consent Date
consented_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when consent was given (required for historical import, e.g. 2024-01-15T10:00:00Z).

custom_source.label: Custom Source
custom_source.description: Label for the subscription source (e.g. "Website Form").

unsubscribeProfile.label: Unsubscribe Profile
unsubscribeProfile.description: Unsubscribe profiles from email or SMS marketing on a list.

profile_ids.label: Profile Ids
profile_ids.description: Select one or more Klaviyo profiles. Several IDs go in as a JSON array, such as ["01H...","01J..."].

unsubscribe_email.label: Unsubscribe from Email
unsubscribe_email.description: Unsubscribe selected profiles from email marketing.

unsubscribe_sms.label: Unsubscribe from SMS
unsubscribe_sms.description: Unsubscribe selected profiles from SMS marketing.

unsubscribe_sms_transactional.label: Unsubscribe from SMS Transactional
unsubscribe_sms_transactional.description: Unsubscribe selected profiles from SMS transactional messages.
